notes.title: Issue regarding claiming DLC content
notes.notes:
For players that have bought any of the available DLCs, there's an existing issue causing the content to not be available to be claimed in the v1.1.0 version of the game. We have released a hotfix update to fix this issue, please make sure to update your game to v1.1.2 before you try to claim the DLC in SiLambat.

We are sorry for the inconvenience caused.

Thank you for your patience and support.

=================================================================================

Bagi teman-teman yang sudah membeli DLC, ada bug dalam v1.1.0 dimana DLC tidak dapat di-claim di dalam game. Kami sudah merilis update untuk memperbaiki masalah ini, pastikan kalian update gamenya ke versi 1.1.2 terlebih dahulu sebelum mencoba claim DLC di SiLambat.

Kami mohon maaf untuk ketidaknyamanannya.

Terima kasih atas kesabaran dan dukungan anda.

notes.title: Monster Museum is Out Now on Steam Early Access!
notes.notes:
Have you ever dreamed of having your own museum where you can collect monsters?
Dream no further, because now you can do it in Monster Museum!
In this world, you can summon and collect monsters inspired by mythologies around the world and display them at your very own museum.
